lede: The biggest item this week is the San Miguel County BOCC meeting on August 5, where three Land Use Code amendments go to public hearing — including changes to who qualifies as an 'Qualified Owner,' a wildfire areas update, and a continued hearing on nonconforming lots, all heading toward formal votes. The Open Space Commission meets Monday to pick a preferred trail alignment for the Valley Floor River Trail, with three routes on the table near mapped wetlands. Mountain Village's Design Review Board takes up three multifamily projects Thursday, including a conditional-use permit.

notable.stake: Commission selects Valley Floor River Trail route from three alignment options.
Three Land Use Code amendments — including ownership rules and wildfire areas — go to public hearing.
Land Use Code definition changes being shaped; definitions determine what rules mean in practice.
Conditional-use permit and multifamily architecture reviews up for decision in Mountain Village.
